claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army record cannot establish Robert B Connor's chronology, occupation or employment.
claims.match_notes: Both printed source rows remain visible. Robert's printed Private rank supports enlisted classification, but no Army occupation or date is transferred from the different-name record.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 90 and complete Army exact-name comparison; Thomas B Connole exact-name and Connolly variants; OSS/CIA, Catalog, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, newspaper, current Library of Congress and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: No exact full-initial Army row or reliable public identity bridge was found. Similar Connolly spellings lack the exact index form, OSS context and Box 139 evidence.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. This is not evidence that no employer existed.
research_attempts.next_action: Establish identity, variants and pre-OSS chronology in Box 139.
